title: the flock that loses one and finds it again
mutation_directive: embed-narrative-arc-into-boids: one straggler, three stages, the flock waits
concept: Direct response to user feedback on nsz: 'has hope but lacks depth of human/life experience.' Reynolds boids alone is mechanics. sav embeds an emotional 4-stage arc INSIDE the dynamics: 480 ordinary birds + 1 straggler with weakened perception and a remembered drift. A 'cohesion memory' tracks how tight the flock is over time. State machine: TOGETHER (cohesion>0.85) → LOSS (straggler>4.5 units away) → SEEKING (cohesion<0.5, flock SLOWS to 55% speed and turns toward the lost one) → RETURN (cohesion>0.65 again, flock pulses brighter, 85% speed). Palette tracks the arc: warm dawn-amber when together, cool steel-blue + violet when lost, climbing back to amber on return. Background is a real dawn-sky vertical gradient (deep navy → plum → terracotta → warm sand) instead of pure black — the flock moves through real atmosphere at a real time-of-day. Straggler is rendered larger and brighter so the eye finds it before the brain registers what's happening.
